audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 was 'Skill' while whys[0] says Sylas chips Skaarl with Chain Lash and Kled has no level-1 answer; row 6 was 'Kled' while whys[6] and spikes[3] both say a Riftmaker/Rylai's Sylas out-heals and out-lasts Kled.
audit.why: Chain Lash is 775 range at level 1 against a melee with nothing to answer it, and Kled's burst is frontloaded while Kingslayer's heal drops to a 6s cooldown when maxed.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 -> Sylas (4/10) and 6 -> Sylas (4/10) as paired full+content rows. The chart then matches the packet exactly and the middle rows, which were already right, are untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a flat warning with no numbers.
audit.why: Hijack is 80s at rank 1 but only 30s at rank 3, 950 range. That is what makes 'never ult first' a rule rather than a suggestion — late in the game his steal is almost always available, whereas at 6 there is a real 80-second window after he spends it.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], mid and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the 80s/30s figures.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that none of Sylas's abilities are named, Kled's Bear Trap was again credited with percent-HP damage, and Chain Lash's delayed detonation and Petricite Burst were never mentioned.
audit.why: Chain Lash damages and slows on contact, then explodes AGAIN from the intersection point after a delay — stepping off the cross after the first hit halves it. Petricite Burst stores a charge on every spell cast that his next attack spends for bonus magic damage plus attack speed, so his damage comes from weaving auto-attacks between spells, not from spells alone. Kingslayer (W) is the only heal in the kit and it is 400 range, 12s at rank 1 falling to 6s.
audit.corrected: Abilities named on the correct slots; the Chain Lash delay and the passive weave added to early; 'percent-HP Q' removed from whys[2], whys[5] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interaction entry — Sylas sustains through chip via Kingslayer, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades — appeared nowhere in prose.
audit.why: report[8] already buys Executioner's Calling but no field told the user when the anti-heal actually matters: before you commit to a long fight, not after he is topped off.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing added to mid and late.

edits.before: Sylas concedes nothing at level 1 — his Q comes online and he can poke your Skaarl health with the spear edge, so don't waste mount HP face-tanking it. The lane flips at 2 and 3: your W shotgun procs and the E-W-E re-E combo out-burst him before his W drain and Q heal can stitch the trade back up. Land Q (Bear Trap) to stick him in place, yank in, dump W, and E out before he chains his E-stun. Dodge his E second-cast — that's the stun that lets him drain you for free.
edits.after: Sylas concedes nothing at level 1 — Chain Lash reaches 775 and its intersection point detonates a second time after a short delay, so step off the cross and half of it misses. The lane flips at 2 and 3: Violent Tendencies and the E-W-E re-E combo out-burst him before Kingslayer can stitch the trade back up. Land Bear Trap to stick him, yank in, dump the four attacks, and E out. Note his passive: every spell arms one attack that whirls his chains, so he wants to weave, not stand and cast.

edits.before: This is the genuinely even stretch. Your remount sustain keeps pace with his Q/W drain, so short trades go your way but extended ones let him heal it all back. At 6 the big rule: he can R-steal your Chaaaaaaaaarge, so never burn your ult to engage when his R is up — he'll turn your knockback into his own engage on you. Trade on his E cooldown, because once his chain-dash stun is down he can't both drain and escape your re-E.
edits.after: This is the genuinely even stretch. Your remount sustain keeps pace with Chain Lash and Kingslayer, so short trades go your way while extended ones let him heal it all back — Grievous Wounds is what breaks that, so have it before you commit to long fights. At 6 the big rule: Hijack takes your Chaaaaaaaaarge and falls to 30s by rank 3, so never burn your ult first while his R is up. Trade once his E is spent — that 400-range recast is his way back to you.

edits.before: This is where he pulls ahead. Once Sylas has Riftmaker/Rylai his Q/W lifesteal heals through your burst and his chain-E kite means you can't pin him for a full combo, while your frontloaded Eclipse spike flattens. Your only path is the lead you built in lane — if you snowballed levels 2-3 and first item, end it. If the lane went even, respect his sustained AP DPS, don't solo-commit into a topped-off Sylas, and look to R-roam for picks elsewhere rather than forcing the losing 1v1.
edits.after: This is where he pulls ahead. Once Sylas has Riftmaker and Rylai's, Kingslayer heals through your burst on a 6-second cooldown and his chain-dash means you can't pin him for a full combo, while your frontloaded Eclipse spike flattens. Your only path is the lead you built in lane — if you snowballed levels 2-3 and first item, end it. If lane went even, keep Grievous Wounds on him, never solo-commit into a topped-off Sylas, and R-roam for picks instead.

edits.after: Stack AP and survive to mid-game where Kingslayer and Riftmaker outheal your burst

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Kingslayer: 12s at rank 1 but only 6s once maxed — that heal is why every long trade loses. - Hijack: 80s at rank 1 and just 30s at rank 3, 950 range — never ult first while it is up. - Your R: 140s, kill windows only, never chip.

notes: I deliberately did NOT touch dosFull[0].d or report[5].t, which describe Abduct as a 'dash + stun (recast pull)'. Riot's description for Abscond/Abduct says only that he dashes and can recast to throw chains and pull HIMSELF to an enemy hit — no stun is stated and the kit carries no hardCC flag on E, but an absent flag means unknown, not absent, so I left the existing claim alone rather than either restate or delete it. Someone should verify Abduct's stun on the wiki and sweep those two fields. 'W shotgun shots/procs' for Violent Tendencies appears here again.
